name: 保存期間と文字起こしの会話設定
prompt:
Refine the previous Japanese two-row conversation-settings component on an exact 390x148 canvas. Keep all Japanese copy, subtitles, values, row order and original timer/document icons. Correct the geometry: use a flat #F2F2F2 page background and a white rounded card at x16 y30, width358 and height88, with no outline or shadow. The card should be wide and compact. Add exactly one thin #DADADA divider between rows from x68 to x374 near y74; no lower line.

Use dark #1D1D1D icon strokes and labels, gray #6E6E6E subtitles and values, and small light-gray chevrons. Row 1: black timer icon, 「消えるメッセージ」, subtitle 「保存期間を選択」, value 「オフ」. Row 2: black outlined document icon, 「文字起こしの言語」, subtitle 「日本語」, value 「設定」. Use Meiryo Regular 14px/24px for main labels and 12px/16px for subtitles and values. Keep the values aligned at the right. Fit both two-line rows inside the shorter card without overlap.

Every text node has link:null. These are navigation rows, not hyperlinks; do not color any text blue. Blue is reserved for actual hyperlinks per the user's request, and none occur here. Match original screenshot geometry and icons; use the preview for Japanese localization. Ignore the black iPhone home-indicator overlay in the source crop and do not include it in the result. No header, WhatsApp footer, extra rows, additional separators, gradients, shadows or new text.
reviewNotes: Candidate 2 preserves all Japanese copy and values, shows the correct timer/document icon shapes in dark strokes, adds the source divider, and correctly excludes the home-indicator overlay. Residual: the card sits about 4px high and 6px wide at the 390px comparison scale; the first row is about 8px high versus the source crop. The native preview still differs in its timer/document icons, but the original screenshot artwork was preserved. Two attempts used; retain needs-correction.
